veranderings.voor: Toe kom die hoofman self nader as 'n slang met vyf koppe.
veranderings.na: Toe kom die hoofman self, 'n slang met vyf koppe, nader.
veranderings.rede: 'nader as' reads as the comparative 'closer than a snake'; the apposition says the chief is the snake, with the same words and no added length.

vlae.teks: Hy word 'n man, en hy hou die meeste van haar.
vlae.rede: 'die meeste' compares her with nobody named in the sentence, so it reads oddly; the intended meaning (he loves her, or he chooses her above her sister) cannot be fixed without guessing, so the writer should decide.
